title: Charming Home w/ Game Room | 15 Mins to Broadway!
description:
Perfect for large families, group trips, or bachelorette weekenders, this spacious 4-bedroom home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with generous sleeping arrangements, open gather spaces, and a full game room for downtime entertainment.

The space
Bring the whole crew. Ten of you, four bedrooms, and a game room that settles the "what are we doing tonight" question before anyone asks it. Whether it's a bachelorette weekend, a family reunion or a Titans road trip, this is the house where everyone actually stays together: room to sleep, room to cook, room to spread out, and a lake two minutes down the road when Broadway wears you out.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms
⊙ Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bed
⊙ Bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bed & 1 Double Futon
⊙ Bedroom 3: 2 Queen Beds
⊙ Bedroom 4: 2 Double Beds
⊙ Bathrooms: 2 Full Bathrooms + 1 Half Bath (Towels, hairdryers, and essential toiletries included)

Amenities & Highlights
⊙ Fully equipped kitchen for group meal prep
⊙ Dedicated game room and outdoor deck/patio space
⊙ Air conditioning, heating, and high-speed Wi-Fi
⊙ Inexpensive Uber/Lyft rides directly to Broadway

Location Highlights
⊙ Located in a tranquil neighborhood
⊙ Nashville International Airport (BNA): 5–7 minutes away
⊙ Broadway & Downtown Nashville: 15 minutes away
⊙ Grand Ole Opry & Nissan Stadium: ~12–13 minutes away
⊙ Percy Priest Lake: 2 minutes to outdoor water activities

Guest access
The entire space is yours. Please make yourself at home. We utilize a digital lock with your own unique code that is emailed to you two days before check-in.

Other things to note
🧼 We clean with green, organic products to reduce environmental impact.
🚗 Extra parking is first-come, first-served in front of the building.
📞 If issues arise, we’ll act quickly, but there’s no 24/7 on-site staff.
